annotations.title: Household fixed cost burden by province

description: Use for the share of household income that goes to the mortgage, admin fees and utilities, by province. Sztywne koszty gospodarstwa finwire (finwire_fixed_cost_burden): share of net income of a model household (two earners on the regional median wage) taken by the mortgage payment on a 50 m2 flat in the province capital, administrative fee, heating, water, waste, electricity and TV licence; Poland and 16 provinces, monthly, with the share without the mortgage.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary for the region (Poland when omitted), default 12.

region.description: 'polska' or province slug, e.g. mazowieckie, slaskie, kujawsko_pomorskie; omit for all regions.
